notes: Flux — Context Switching Tracker for knowledge workers. A single-file application with IndexedDB persistence that tracks time across tasks, projects, and focus sessions. Three connected workflows: Now (active timer + quick task switching), Dashboard (analytics, project breakdown, weekly charts), History (searchable, filterable, sortable session log with bulk actions). Features: real CRUD with validation, keyboard shortcuts (⌘K palette, Space start/pause, N new task, F finish, J/K navigate), command palette, import/export JSON/CSV, sample data on first run, onboarding flow, idle detection, focus sessions (Pomodoro/deep work), project management with colors, tag system, responsive design (1440px+ primary, tablet/mobile reflow), WCAG AA contrast, reduced motion support, no external dependencies. Tested: opens cold, data survives reload, all three workflows share state, search/filter/sort work, import/export round-trip works, empty/error states handled, keyboard-first with touch support.
